newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.
newsitem.headline: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping soybeans and soy products:

Vessels: Idannitsa loading 15,500 mixed cargo (soybeans/meal). General Vladimir Zain loading 20,600 tonnes soymeal. Alpheos loading 49,000 tonnes soymeal. Axion 1 loading 55,000 soybeans. Sea Harmony loading 25,000 tonnes soymeal.
Waiting to dock, nine vessels for soymeal, six for soybeans and two for mixed cargo (soybeans/meal).
Road: 866 trucks carrying soybeans arrived on April 28, 311 trucks with soymeal and 94 with vegetable oils, including soyoil.

Waiting to dock, Glory Hope to load 53,000 tonnes soybeans, Alpha Gemini to load 56,700 tonnes soybeans and Captain George I to load 55,000 tonnes soybeans. At Cargill private terminal, Ignace Daszynsky loading 10,000 tonnes soymeal.
